result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You are being called back (recall) for more tests. This follows your screening mammogram (breast x-ray) on 16 September 2026.

Being called back does not mean you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer.

At the visit you may have more mammograms. You may have an ultrasound scan. In some cases you may have a biopsy (a small sample taken for testing).

You will usually get most of your results on the same day. The visit may take up to 4 hours.

## What you need to do
1. Come to your appointment at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital. It is on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00.
2. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as possible.
3. You can bring a friend or family member. This is your choice.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: your screening mammogram.
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: recall appointment, Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
- Medicines: the letter lists no medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Which tests will I have at the visit?
- When will I get all of my results?
- Can I bring someone with me?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
